Be plain and direct. Prefer short sentences.

## Rules

- No performance claims without a cited benchmark.

## Terminology

- **customer**: an organization that has deployed an Acme Hub.
- Prefer "Hub" over "instance".

## Things We Avoid

- The word "revolutionary".
